title: Government
description: Ghana is governed as a presidential republic. The system of government shapes daily life through laws, services, and the citizen's relationship to the state. Its modern form dates to 1957 (independence) — and like all governments, it continues to evolve with its people.

title: Independence and statehood

title: Languages

title: Currency and money
description: Money in Ghana: the Ghanaian cedi. Travelers should learn the denominations, the tipping customs, and whether cards or cash rule daily life. Exchange rates move, but the habit of checking prices in local terms keeps budgets honest.
